newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rio de Janeiro state says upbeat on sale of Banerj.
newsitem.headline: Rio de Janeiro state says upbeat on sale of Banerj.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state is confident its bank Banerj will finally be privatized next Tuesday, said Rio's Finance Secretary Marco Aurelio Alencar.
"The state is completely optimistic that the bank will be privatized. We are not working on the assumption that the bank won't be sold," Alencar told a news conference.
Alencar confirmed the list of prequalified bidders for the Banerj sale on June 17.

Those bidders are: Bradesco, Banco Itau, General Electric's GE Capital, BankBoston's Brazil unit, Credit Commerciale de France's CCF do Brasil, Banco BBA Creditanstalt, Cia de Investimentos Latino-Americana and BCN.
All prequalified bidders, except for BCN, had prequalified for the auction last year, when the state first attempted to privatize the bank.
To actually bid at the auction, prequalified investors have to present financial guarantees to the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange's clearing house on Friday, Alencar said.

Paulo Ferraz, president of private bank Bozano, Simonsen that was hired to manage Banerj, said Bradesco and Itau, which last year signed up for the auction, continue to be interested in acquiring the state bank.
"Interested investors continue to be Bradesco and Itau," he said, adding that BCN may be also interested.

Ferraz said the auction would not take place next Tuesday only if the Rio de Janeiro state Legislative Assembly and Congress' Senate fail to approve a key federal loan or in the case of court injunctions blocking the sale.
So far five lawsuits have been filed against the sell-off.

Ferraz said he expects the state assembly and the Senate to approve the 2.9 billion real loan by federal bank Caixa Economica Federal (CEF) before Tuesday. The loan is necessary to cover debts related to Banerj's pension fund.
Banerj, formally known as Banco Banerj SA, will be sold for at least 310 million reais at a closed-envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro bourse.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5511 2485412))
